title: Seeming to have an experience is representing oneself as having it

statements.text: Seeming to have a greenish experience, in the illusionist sense, is introspectively representing oneself as having a greenish experience, which can occur without having one. The content of introspective representations is fixed by non-phenomenal, causal or functional factors, so no greenish mode of presentation is needed.

sources.quote: They mean introspectively representing oneself as having a greenish experience, and one can do this without having a greenish experience.
